items.title: Ship dark mode for the settings page
items.what: Settings is the last page still hardcoded to light colors.

notes.text: Theme tokens already exist in theme.css; settings never adopted them.
Agent found 23 hardcoded colors across 6 files. Replacing them with tokens.
Contrast audit running on the new palette.

pages.title: Palette
pages.html:
The settings page now reads every color from the shared tokens.

Changed

  • settings.css: 14 colors to tokens
  • toggle.css: 5 colors to tokens
  • form.css: 4 colors to tokens

Left alone

  • Brand logo colors (fixed by design)

notes.text: Fails about 1 run in 12 on CI, never locally.
Cause: the test reads the clock twice across a minute boundary. Two fixes possible.

items.line: Freeze the clock in the checkout fixture?
items.sub: One-line change; every checkout test gets the same time.

items.line: Pass the clock into CheckoutService instead?
items.sub: Bigger change, but no test can hit this again.

items.line: Quarantine the test until the fix lands?

notes.text: Two dependencies pin older versions; both have releases that support 3.13.

items.title: API error codes
items.what: Every error the public API returns, with what the client should do.

pages.title: Codes
pages.html:
• E_AUTH: token missing or expired. Sign in again.
  • E_RATE: too many requests. Retry after the Retry-After header.
  • E_CART: cart changed during checkout. Reload the cart.
